Applications must be submitted online on or before 20-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Research Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the IIT Madras Research Associate-I recruitment is 20th August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in Management, Commerce, or related fields to be eligible for the Research Associate-I position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate-I post in the IIT Madras recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate-I post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 58,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIT Madras Research Associate-I recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the IIT Madras Research Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the experience required for the Research Associate-I role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have 3 to 5 years of experience in Corporate Finance, Banking, Financial Services, or Fintech research to be considered for the Research Associate-I position.

faq.question: Q8. What are the key stages in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate-I post includes Shortlisting of applications, followed by a Test/Interview, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Does IIT Madras offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation for reserved categories is not explicitly detailed in the provided summary. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for specific details.
